1.1 To ensure the a safe environment for vulnerable patients

2.0 SCOPE:

2.1 Hospital Management

2.2 Health Care Providers

2.3 Patients

3.1 Doctors

3.2 Nursing staff

3.3 Hospital staff

4.1 COP-Care of Patient

5.0 DEFINITION: Nil

6.0 REFERENCE:

6.1 NABH: Accreditation Standards for Ayurved Hospitals 2nd Edition April 2016.

7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1. Policies and procedures are documented and are in accordance with the prevailing laws and the national and international guidelines.

7.2 Care is organized and delivered in accordance with the policies and procedures.

7.3 The organization provides for a safe and secure environment for this vulnerable group.

7.4 A documented procedure exists for obtaining informed consent from the appropriate legal representative.

7.5 Staff is trained to care for this vulnerable group.

8. 0 PROCESSES

8.1 Vulnerable patients are identified by treating Doctor, risk management and monitoring of these patients will be observed twice in a day. All patients are assessed and well documented by treating doctors.

8.1.1 Wheelchair accessibility is possible within the hospital.

8.1.2 Handrails are provided for the senior citizens to move around the hospital.

8.1.3 For children, disabled and elderly patients where ever possible arrangement is made for bed side accommodation of bystanders.

8.1.4 Signage boards with contrasting colors; large fonts in English as well as the regional language (Marathi) are placed to help senior citizens and disabled people.

1. Parking spaces are reserved for the disabled near to the entrance of the hospital.

2. Clear pathways are provided for the disabled and senior citizens to move around at their own pace.

3. Washrooms with grab bars are designed mainly for the disabled and aged people.

4. In registration counters senior citizens, physically handicapped are given priority.

8.2 Hospital adopted standard guidelines for “care of vulnerable patient” and other care as per treatment manual.

8.3 Hospital provide proper environment taking into account the requirement of the vulnerable patient. Like anti-skid floor, ramps with railings for disabled, grab bars etc.

8.4 Hospital obtains inform consent format from vulnerable patient or by their representative family in hospital standard informed consent format 8.5 All hospital staffs are involved in the care of this group adequately trained in identifying and meeting their needs.
